links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM triage outputs across repeated runs
links.effect: Reproducibility testing revealed substantial variability in 23% of cases, indicating non-deterministic output behavior.
links.quote: Reproducibility testing revealed substantial variability in 23% of cases, indicating non-deterministic output behavior for clinically relevant decisions.

links.outcome: Calibration of verbalized confidence in LLM triage outputs
links.effect: Most models showed systematic overconfidence, with expected calibration errors from verbalized confidence ranging from 0.099 to 0.355.
links.quote: Most models demonstrated moderate or lower agreement and systematic overconfidence, with expected calibration errors (ECE) based on verbalized confidence ranging from 0.099 to 0.355.

links.outcome: Agreement of LLM ESI predictions with nurse-assigned ESI levels
links.effect: Quadratic-weighted kappa ranged from 0.18 to 0.75 across models; only structured stepwise prompting reached substantial agreement (0.747).
links.quote: Only a structured stepwise prompting strategy achieved substantial agreement (κ_qw = 0.747), approaching reported human inter-rater reliability.
